title: Accounting & Bookkeeping
shortDescription: Accurate, timely bookkeeping, management reporting, and accounting advisory tailored for growing enterprises.
tagline: Real-Time Financial Clarity to Drive Smarter Business Decisions
overview: Our Accounting & Bookkeeping practice provides end-to-end financial record management, reconciliation, and statutory financial reporting. We blend cutting-edge cloud accounting infrastructure with meticulous human oversight to ensure your ledgers are pristine, audit-ready, and compliant with all applicable accounting standards (Ind AS / IFRS / US GAAP).
whyItMatters: Sound financial records are the backbone of sustainable business growth. Without timely financial visibility, leadership makes critical decisions in the dark, risking cash flow crunches and regulatory penalties. ANS delivers spotless books so you can focus 100% on scaling your enterprise.

offerings.title: End-to-End Bookkeeping
offerings.description: Daily recording of financial transactions, journal entries, ledger maintenance, and accounts payable/receivable management.

offerings.title: Financial Statement Preparation
offerings.description: Comprehensive Balance Sheets, Profit & Loss accounts, Cash Flow statements, and notes adhering to statutory frameworks.

offerings.title: Accounting Advisory & GAAP Convergence
offerings.description: Expert advisory on complex accounting treatments, revenue recognition, lease accounting, and transition across GAAP/Ind AS.

offerings.title: Payroll Processing & Compliance
offerings.description: Full-cycle payroll computation, salary slip generation, TDS deduction, PF, ESI, and statutory labor law compliance filing.

offerings.title: Accounts Outsourcing (Shared Services)
offerings.description: Dedicated back-office accounting teams providing cost-effective, scalable, and secure finance functions for global and domestic firms.

offerings.title: Bank & Ledger Reconciliations
offerings.description: Multi-currency bank account reconciliations, vendor/customer ledger balancing, and inter-company reconciliation.

deliverables: Monthly MIS & P&L statements within 5 business days
Cloud accounting software setup (Zoho, QuickBooks, Tally Prime, SAP)

faqs.question: Can ANS integrate with our existing accounting software?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our team is proficient in Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Tally Prime, SAP, Xero, and Busy. We can either operate within your established environment or assist in migrating to an optimized cloud setup.

faqs.question: How often will we receive financial updates?
faqs.answer: We provide weekly cash summaries, monthly comprehensive MIS reports, and quarterly board decks, with real-time dashboards accessible on demand.

faqs.question: Is our sensitive financial data secure?
faqs.answer: We enforce enterprise-grade security protocols, signed NDAs, encrypted data storage, and role-based access control across all client engagements.

title: Auditing & Assurance
shortDescription: Independent, thorough, risk-based audit and assurance services that build stakeholder and investor trust.
tagline: Rigorous Assurance to Safeguard Assets and Strengthen Governance
overview: Our Auditing & Assurance practice delivers high-caliber statutory and internal audits designed to validate financial integrity, evaluate internal controls, and identify operational efficiencies. We employ modern risk-focused auditing methodologies to deliver actionable insights beyond simple compliance checkmarks.
whyItMatters: Auditing is not just a regulatory mandate—it is the cornerstone of market credibility. An exhaustive audit uncovers hidden leakage, fortifies fraud prevention, assures investors and lenders, and guarantees long-term institutional resilience.

offerings.title: Statutory Audit
offerings.description: Independent audit of annual financial statements in accordance with the Companies Act, ensuring true and fair representation of financial status.

offerings.title: Internal Audit & Risk Management
offerings.description: Systematic review of internal control frameworks (ICoFR), operational procedures, and enterprise risk mitigation strategies.

offerings.title: Stock & Asset Verification
offerings.description: Physical inventory verification, fixed asset tagging, valuation reconciliation, and impairment testing across factory & warehouse locations.

offerings.title: Special Audit & Forensic Review
offerings.description: Targeted investigation into irregularities, dispute assessments, transaction tracing, and compliance audits for regulatory bodies or lenders.

offerings.title: Concurrent & Bank Audits
offerings.description: Real-time auditing of financial transactions, working capital reviews, stock statements verification, and NPA monitoring for institutions.

offerings.title: Management & Operational Audit
offerings.description: In-depth operational workflow analysis to identify process bottlenecks, resource wastage, and productivity enhancement opportunities.

deliverables: Independent Statutory Audit Reports with complete annexures
Executive Internal Audit Reports highlighting high-risk findings & action plans
Physical asset reconciliation certificates and valuation variance reports

faqs.question: What is the difference between Statutory and Internal Audit?
faqs.answer: Statutory Audit is an external legal obligation to certify whether financial statements present a true and fair view. Internal Audit is a management tool focused on operational risk, internal controls, and process efficiency.

faqs.question: How do you minimize operational disruption during an audit?
faqs.answer: We establish a structured pre-audit information checklist and use secure digital data exchange platforms, conducting sampling and inquiries with minimal friction to your day-to-day operations.

title: Taxation & Regulatory Compliance
shortDescription: End-to-end direct tax, GST, international tax advisory, and representation services to optimize your tax position.
tagline: Proactive Tax Planning and Frictionless Regulatory Compliance
overview: Navigating the rapidly evolving tax ecosystem requires proactive strategy and absolute technical precision. ANS offers comprehensive Direct Taxation, GST, and Indirect Tax advisory. We ensure that our clients capitalize on all legitimate incentives, avoid compliance pitfalls, and effectively manage litigation before appellate authorities.
whyItMatters: Tax laws are dynamic, complex, and carry steep penalties for oversight. A strategic tax approach safeguards cash flow, optimizes overall tax liability legally, and insulates leadership from unwarranted litigation and dispute stress.

offerings.title: Corporate & Direct Taxation
offerings.description: Income tax planning, corporate return filings, Advance Tax computation, MAT calculation, and Minimum Alternate Tax optimization.

offerings.title: GST & Indirect Tax Advisory
offerings.description: GST registration, monthly GSTR-1 & 3B filings, annual GSTR-9/9C reconciliation, input tax credit (ITC) maximization, and classification audits.

offerings.title: Tax Litigation & Representation
offerings.description: Drafting robust responses to show-cause notices, handling scrutiny assessments, faceless assessments, and representation before CIT(A) and tribunals.

offerings.title: International Taxation & Transfer Pricing
offerings.description: Cross-border tax structuring, Transfer Pricing documentation (Form 3CEB), Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements (DTAA), and withholding tax compliance.

offerings.title: Expatriate & Individual Tax Planning
offerings.description: High-net-worth individual (HNI) tax structuring, executive compensation planning, NRI tax advisory, and capital gains optimization.

offerings.title: Tax Due Diligence & Health Checks
offerings.description: Pre-acquisition tax risk assessment, historical compliance audits, and mitigation of potential tax exposure for corporate restructuring.

deliverables: Timely and error-free statutory tax filings (Direct & Indirect)
Comprehensive Input Tax Credit (ITC) optimization matrices
Representation briefs and legal submissions for tax notices
Strategic quarterly advance tax estimation roadmaps

faqs.question: How do you assist with sudden GST or Income Tax notices?
faqs.answer: We quickly examine the notice, gather transactional evidence, formulate legally grounded responses, and represent you directly on the portal or before the appellate authority.

faqs.question: Can you assist with cross-border international taxation?
faqs.answer: Yes, we handle Transfer Pricing studies, DTAA treaty benefits, 15CA/15CB certificates, and Foreign Remittance taxation.

offerings.title: Business Valuation & Modeling

offerings.title: Transaction Advisory & Due Diligence

offerings.title: Debt Syndication & Working Capital Advisory

deliverables: Dynamic 3-statement financial models with sensitivity toggles
Executive Virtual CFO monthly board review decks
Comprehensive Financial & Tax Due Diligence (FDD) Reports
Certified Business Valuation Reports for statutory & investment rounds

faqs.question: What is a Virtual CFO engagement model?
faqs.answer: A Virtual CFO provides dedicated high-level strategic financial steering, attending executive meetings and managing banking/investor relations on a flexible retainer basis.

faqs.question: When should a company engage transaction due diligence?
faqs.answer: Before finalizing any merger, acquisition, minority investment, or business sale, due diligence is vital to uncover unrecorded liabilities and validate true earnings.
